description: Per-call structured extraction for Lale Bistro Reservation Assistant calls. Field names are snake_case for backend analytics, independent of OloVoice's own camelCase tool-config convention.

intent.description: Primary caller intent handled during this call.

call_outcome.description: What actually happened by the end of the call.

reservation_code.description: Confirmation code involved in this call, if any (created, looked up, or cancelled). Null if none.

reservation_date.description: Reservation date in YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Istanbul), if applicable. Null if none.

reservation_time.description: Reservation start time in 24-hour HH:MM (Europe/Istanbul), if applicable. Null if none.

party_size.description: Party size discussed, if applicable. Null if none (including parties larger than 8, which this backend does not handle online).

tool_succeeded.description: True if the relevant backend tool call(s) completed successfully with the desired outcome; false on tool failure, timeout, or business rejection (e.g. no availability).

human_followup_required.description: True if the caller should be followed up with by a human (party > 8, repeated tool failure, explicit request for a human, complaint, or other situation out of the assistant's scope).

failure_reason.description: Short machine-readable failure code when tool_succeeded is false or call_outcome is 'failed', e.g. no_availability, closed_monday, outside_opening_hours, past_time, not_found, tool_timeout, tool_error. Null when not applicable.
